---

This map shows community resilience centers in Lake County that are part of the
[Community Organizations Active in Disaster (COAD)](https://www.lakecountycoad.org)
network. These sites provide shelter, cooling, and resources during extreme heat
events and other emergencies.

For county emergency preparedness resources, visit the
[Lake County Office of Climate Resiliency](https://www.lakecountyca.gov/1436/Office-of-Climate-Resiliency).

---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(leaflet)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

sites <- read_csv("sites.csv")

# Status colors
status_colors <- c(
  "Active" = "#27ae60",
  "Setup"  = "#e67e22"
)

status_labels <- c(
  "Active" = "Active — open during events",
  "Setup"  = "Setup — not yet accepting residents"
)

# Build popup HTML for each site
make_popup <- function(name, status, address, phone, website, facebook, hours, services, notes) {
  lines <- paste0("<b style='font-size:14px;'>", name, "</b><br>")
  lines <- paste0(lines,
    "<span style='color:", status_colors[status], ";font-weight:bold;'>",
    status_labels[status], "</span><br><br>"
  )
  lines <- paste0(lines, address, "<br>")
  if (!is.na(phone) && phone != "")
    lines <- paste0(lines, "&#128222; <a href='tel:", phone, "'>", phone, "</a><br>")
  if (!is.na(website) && website != "")
    lines <- paste0(lines, "&#127760; <a href='", website, "' target='_blank'>Website</a><br>")
  if (!is.na(facebook) && facebook != "")
    lines <- paste0(lines, "&#128100; <a href='", facebook, "' target='_blank'>Facebook</a><br>")
  if (!is.na(hours) && hours != "")
    lines <- paste0(lines, "<br><b>Hours:</b> ", hours, "<br>")
  if (!is.na(services) && services != "")
    lines <- paste0(lines, "<b>Services:</b> ", services, "<br>")
  if (!is.na(notes) && notes != "")
    lines <- paste0(lines, "<br><i>", notes, "</i>")
  lines
}

sites <- sites %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(popup = make_popup(name, status, address, phone, website,
                            facebook, hours, services, notes)) %>%
  ungroup()

leaflet(sites) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  setView(lng = -122.85, lat = 38.98, zoom = 10) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng        = ~lng,
    lat        = ~lat,
    radius     = 11,
    color      = ~status_colors[status],
    fillColor  = ~status_colors[status],
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    weight     = 2,
    stroke     = TRUE,
    popup      = ~popup,
    label      = ~name,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style     = list("font-weight" = "bold", "font-size" = "13px"),
      direction = "top",
      offset    = c(0, -12)
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors   = unname(status_colors),
    labels   = unname(status_labels),
    title    = "Site Status",
    opacity  = 0.9
  )
```
